title: DFT, Molecular Docking, and Molecular Dynamics Analysis of Electronic Structure, Reactivity, and PTP1B Binding of Phenylacetic and Benzylmalonic Acid-Functionalized C(60) Derivatives.
authors: Rodriguez-Celestino, Veronica; Cisneros-Garcia, Zuriel Natanael; Rodriguez-Zavala, Jaime Gustavo; Mendez-Barrientos, Carlos Ivan; Facio-Munoz, Jose Guadalupe
one_liner_zh: 该文用DFT、分子对接和MD研究C60衍生物与PTP1B的结合，虽对象非蛋白但对接/MD方法可迁移至蛋白结构计算，故给6分。
abstract: Water-soluble C(60) derivatives functionalized with phenylacetic acid (PhAA) and benzylmalonic acid (BnMA), together with their di- and tetrahydroxylated derivatives, were investigated using density functional theory, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations to evaluate their electronic structure, local and global reactivity, and interactions with protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B (PTP1B). Successive hydroxylation steps were thermodynamically favorable, while electronic structure and reactivity analyses indicated that the fullerene cage retains features compatible with further ROS-related reactivity after hydroxylation. Electrostatic potential analysis revealed differentiated polarity between the fullerene and functionalization regions. Docking showed functionalization-dependent binding modes: PhAA-derived systems sampled both peripheral regions near the WPD and R loops and the catalytic pocket, whereas BnMA-derived systems consistently occupied the catalytic site and interacted with key residues, including Cys215 and Arg221. Molecular dynamics showed reduced flexibility in functionally relevant regions, reorganization of correlated motions, and average catalytic-pocket conformations that were more open than in apo-PTP1B. Overall, these results support the potential of these derivatives for ROS-related reactivity and modulation of PTP1B, although experimental validation is required to establish their biological activity.
abstract_zh: 采用密度泛函理论、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，研究了以苯乙酸（PhAA）和苄基丙二酸（BnMA）功能化的水溶性C(60)衍生物及其二羟基化和四羟基化衍生物，以评估其电子结构、局部和全局反应性，以及与蛋白酪氨酸磷酸酶1B（PTP1B）的相互作用。逐步羟基化步骤在热力学上是有利的，而电子结构和反应性分析表明，富勒烯笼在羟基化后保留了与进一步ROS相关反应性兼容的特征。静电势分析揭示了富勒烯区域与功能化区域之间的极性差异。对接结果显示功能化依赖性结合模式：PhAA衍生系统采样了靠近WPD和R环的外围区域以及催化口袋，而BnMA衍生系统则持续占据催化位点，并与关键残基（包括Cys215和Arg221）相互作用。分子动力学模拟显示，功能相关区域的灵活性降低，相关运动发生重组，平均催化口袋构象比脱辅基PTP1B更为开放。总体而言，这些结果支持这些衍生物在ROS相关反应性和PTP1B调节方面的潜力，但需实验验证以确定其生物活性。
